## Delivered

`db/deploy/organization_cascade.sql` (+revert/+verify+plan line) — `organization_match` append-only match-record log (`relation_type` `same_as`|`possibly_same`, `match_tier` 0–2, `disposition` `auto_link`|`surfaced`, `match_evidence`+`evidence_claims` per SIG-IDENT-025, `input_digest` UNIQUE → +0 re-run, `left_entity < right_entity` canonical pair), `organization_run` (completion marker written last), `organization_execution` (ADR-123 latest-execution semantics). Grants: `sig_materialize` SELECT+INSERT only, `sig_export` SELECT; off the public read allowlist like `camera_site_*`. Additive — nothing existing altered.

`resolution/org_cascade_pg.py` — the materializer. `read_org_candidates` assembles each org entity's surface (lane identifiers with `asserted_by_claim` provenance, cached/claim name, latest `organization_jurisdiction` state, class, the `org_crosswalk_entry` flag via `sig.connector.subject`). `plan_org_cascade` is pure: tier 0 exact shared authoritative id (ORI validity + civil-ORI refusal, SIG-IDENT-003), tier 1 established registry crosswalk bridged by a crosswalk-entry entity (evidence names the bridging entity), tier 2 normalized name+state+class minus the committed collision exclusion → `possibly_same`/`surfaced` — recorded, never linked (SIG-CONF-004 / ADR-L3-B §4). `materialize_org_cascade` writes batched INSERT-only rows, run record last, one execution row per execution. `read_org_cascade_runs` is the latest-completed-execution read seam. `sig-resolution org-cascade --dsn … [--role] [--dry-run]` wired in `resolution/cli.py`.

`db/crosswalk_intake.py` — `sig.org-crosswalk-report/1` gains `cascade`: latest run's link counts + the name-duplicate rate *after* the run's same_as edges union (the duplicate-agency-rate fall the acceptance measures); `{"run_key": null}` before any run, `null` on a spine without the change.
